name: Suki na Dake!
source:
It began with the words from Kyoko, my cousin.
"Take care of my little sister for a while!"
Utsuho, her little sister, was still very young. However, taking care of her wasn't easy as I thought....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ058357.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一切都始于亲戚家的京子姐姐的一句话。
“帮我照顾一阵子妹妹！”
她的妹妹Utsuho年纪还很小。不过，照顾她远没有我想得那么容易……

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ058357.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
